€1P. (गलति, जगाल, अगालीत्, गलितुम्, गलित) 
__1 To drop, drip, ooze, trickle; जलमिव गलत्युपदिष्टम् [[

.]] 
__2 To drop or fall down; शरदमच्छगलद्वसनोपमा [[Śi. 6. 42]]; 9. 75; प्रतोदा जगलुः [[

.]] 
__3 To vanish, disappear, pass away, be removed; गलति मध्यरात्रे [[Dk.]]; शैशवेन सह गलति गुरुजनस्नेहः [[

.]] 
__4 To eat, swallow (connected with गॄ). -Caus. or 10 U. (p. p. गलित) 
__1 To pour out. 
__2 To filter, strain. 
__3 To flow (Ā.). 4 To fuse, liquefy, dissolve, melt. -With निस् to ooze or flow out, trickle down; निर्गलिताम्बुगर्भं शरद्घनं नार्दति चातकोऽपि [[

[गल्-भक्षणे बा° करणे अच्] 
__1 The throat, neck; शितिना गलेन विलसन्मरीचिना [[
]]; न गरलं गले कस्तूरीयम्; cf. अजागलस्तन; [[

.]] 
__2 The resin of the Śāla tree. 
__3 A kind of musical instrument. 
__4 A rope. 
__5 A kind of fish. 
__6 A large kind of grass (बृहत्काश). 
-Comp. 
-अङ्कुरः a particular disease of the throat (inflammation). 
-उद्भवः the tuft of hair on the neck of a horse. 
-ओघः tumor in the throat. 
-कम्बलः a bull's dewlap. 
-गण्डः 
__1 enlargement of the glands of the neck. 
__2 goitre. 
-ग्रहः, -ग्रहणम् 
__1 seizing by the throat, throttling, smothering. 
__2 a kind of disease; [[

.]] 
__3 N. of certain days in the dark fortnight of a month:-- i. e. the 4th, 7th, 8th, 9th, 13th and the three following days. 
__4 a day on which a course of study is commenced, but immediately preceding a day on which it is prohibited. 
__5 study, begun but immediately interrupted. 
-चर्मन् n. the gullet, throat. 
-द्वारम् the mouth. 
-मेखला a necklace. 
-वार्त a. 
__1 safe in the work of the throat, able to eat much and digest it, healthy, sound; दृश्यन्ते चैव तीर्थेषु गलवार्तास्तपस्विनः [[

.]] v. l. 
__2 a parasite. 
-विद्रधिः tumor and abscess in the throat. 
-व्रतः a peacock. 
-शुण्डिका the uvula. 
-शुण्डी swelling of the glands of the neck. 
-स्तनी (also गलेस्तनी) a she-goat. 
-हस्तः 
__1 seizing by the throat, throttling, collaring; अनिच्छन्गलहस्तेन ताभिर्निर्वासितस्ततः [[

.]] 
__2 an arrow with a crescent-shaped head; cf. अर्धचन्द्र. 
-हस्तित a. seized by the throat, throttled, strangled; अर्धेन्दुलीलैर्गलहस्तितेव [[
The cheek; especially, the part of the cheek near the corners of the mouth; [[
.]] (Rhetoricians consider this word to be ग्राम्य or vulgar; cf. the instance given in [[K.
]]:--ताम्बूलभृतगल्लोऽयं भल्लं जल्पति मानुषः; but cf. Bhavabhūti's use:--पातालप्रतिमल्लगल्लविवरप्रक्षिप्तसप्तार्णवम् [[

[गल् बा° वुन्] 
__1 The throat, the neck. 
__2 A kind of fish.

__1 A wine-glass. 
__2 Sapphire; see गल्वर्क below.

[गल् भावे ल्युट्] 
__1 Oozing, trickling, dripping. 
__2 Leaking. 
__3 Melting, fusing. 
__4 Falling down or off.

[गल् णिच्-भावे ल्युट्] 
__1 Straining (fluids). 
__2 Fusing, liquefying, melting. 
__3 Reviling; cf. com. on [[

गलन्तिका,
गलन्ती 
__1 A small pitcher. 
__2 A small water-jar with a hole in the bottom from which the water drops upon the object of worship (an image, Liṅga, Tulasī &c.) placed below.

p. p. [गल्-क्त] 
__1 Dropped or fallen down. 
__2 Melted. 
__3 Oozed, flowing. 
__4 Lost, vanished, deprived. 
__5 Untied, got loose. 
__6 Emptied, leaked away. 
__7 Filtered. 
__8 Decayed, impaired. 
__9 Decreased, exhausted; गलितविभवाश्चार्थिषु नृपाः [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-कुष्ठम् advanced or incurable leprosy when the fingers and toes fall off; also गुलत्कुष्ठम् 
-नखदन्त a. one who has lost his claws and teeth; वृद्धो गलितनखदन्तो न कथं विश्वासभूमिः [[

.]] 
-दन्त a. toothless. 
-नयन a. one who has lost his eyes, blind. 
-यौवन a. one who has lost the bloom or charm of youth, grown old; गलितयौवना कामिनी [[

.]] 
-वयस् a. being in the decline of age, in declining years; गलितवयसामिक्ष्वाकूणामिदं हि कुलव्रतम् [[

__1 A multitude of throats. 
__2 A quantity of a particular kind of grass or of ropes made of it.
A kind of bird, (so called from the pendulous fleshy purse hanging from its throat); Adjutant bird.
[गडि, डस्य लः] A strong but lazy bull; see गडि.
f. [गल्-इन्] Abuse, abusive or foul language; ददतु ददतु गालीर्गालिमन्तो भवन्तो वयमपि तदभावाद्गालिदानेऽसमर्थाः [[
m. A kind of gem (चन्द्रकान्त); मसारगल्वर्कमयैर्विभङ्गैर्विभूषितं हेमनिबद्धचकम् [[
€1Ā. (गल्भते, गल्भित) To be bold or confident.

a. 
__1 Bold, confident, audacious. 
__2 Proud, haughty.
A vessel for drinking spirituous liquor; एवं बृहत्तरे गल्लर्कप्रमाणे कुले जातः [[

.]] 
__3 A goblet, a vessel for drinking spirituous liquor; मसारगल्वर्कमुखः [[

__1 The Lodhra tree. 
__2 A kind of ebony. 
__3 N. of a sage, a pupil of Viśvāmitra (said in [[Hariv.]] to be his son).
A particular position of the fingers.

a. 
__1 Drunk, intoxicated. 
__2 Sick, diseased. 
__3 Foolish. 
-तम् Examination; investigation.
